thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Dedicated pool GPU node reporting repeated ECC/PCIe errors; affected pool: novagrid-dedicated-14. Paging infra oncall.
Ingrid K: I’m on it — joining call. Seeing kernel oops on node gpn-14-07.
Matt P: oncall here, pulling logs now. Can someone mute alerts to reduce noise?
ops-oncall-bot: Alerts muted for 30m by Matt P.
Ben (infra): Quick summary from k8s: node gpn-14-07 is flapping Ready->NotReady, kubelet shows "node-status: kernel oops - ECE CORR". Pods being evicted.
Saniya: Which customers on that pool? Is Novagrid on this pool only?
Customer Success - Novagrid: Confirmed Novagrid dedicated pool 14 is in their VPC/Private setup — several inference endpoints active, some lower QPS but steady. They’re on a support window now.
Ingrid K: OK, start N->I: 1) isolate node (taint), 2) drain, 3) reroute traffic to novagrid standby pool if available, 4) hardware diag.
Matt P: Tainting node now: 
```
kubectl taint nodes gpn-14-07 dedicated-fault=true:NoSchedule --overwrite
```
Matt P: Draining: 
```
kubectl drain gpn-14-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Ben (infra): Drain started, pods evicting. Watching for failed evictions (stateful inference containers).
Customer Success - Novagrid: Heads up — we’re seeing 502s to one endpoint. Low volume but repeated. Please advise SLA impact.
Saniya: Oncall to Novagrid: temporary degraded latency for some requests; we’ve started failover to a warm standby. Will update.
Ingrid K: Deploy-bot, can you spin up one cci-warm node in novagrid-dedicated-14-standby?
deploy-bot: Starting warm node pool scale-up: +1 GPU instance requested. ETA ~4m.
Kyle (hardware): I pulled dmesg from gpn-14-07: repeated messages: "NVM Express device error status: Media Error", then PCIe AER: "uevent: Uncorrectable Error, category: RxErr". Looks like intermittent PCIe lane errors.
Ben (infra): Also seeing ECC corrected/uncorrected counters spike on the GPU. Could be degrading GPU hardware or motherboard/slot.
Matt P: For immediate mitigation, keep the taint + drain. If drain didn’t finish in 5m, we will cordon and force-swap endpoints to standby.
Ingrid K: Is this a spot eviction or hardware fault? PD bot initially flagged it as kernel oops rather than spot termination.
ops-oncall-bot: Spot termination checks: instance gpn-14-07 has no recent market bid events; not a spot termination.
Kyle (hardware): Ruling: likely hardware degradation. Recommend RMA the GPU and do node replacement.
Customer Success - Novagrid: We appreciate the quick updates. Can you keep us posted on which endpoints are failing? We’ll prepare customer-side mitigation.
Saniya: List of affected endpoints: novagrid-nlp-embed-prod, novagrid-chat-001 (low QPS). Forwarding to Novagrid support alias.
Matt P: Drain complete — all pods rescheduled except two stateful pods stuck with PVC attach error. Trying manual eviction.
Ben (infra): Manual forcible delete then let controller recreate on standby nodes.
Matt P: Forced delete applied. Controllers rescheduled to new node in standby pool. Health checks passing on ~90% of endpoints.
Ingrid K: Routing update: Smart router policy switched to prefer standby variant for traffic that was previously pinned to gpn-14-07. Happens automatically because we drained and the instanceIDs changed.
Customer Success - Novagrid: Confirming chat endpoints are back to green from our side. One embed worker still showing intermittent timeouts.
Matt P: Investigating embed worker — looks like it landed on a host with slightly different GPU capability (fp16 perf) — performance mismatch causing OOM retries in the container. Rolling back pod resource request to force it to different node.
Ben (infra): Noting operational lesson: we should prefer matching capability when failing over stateful workloads. Opened infra ticket INF-4332.
Ingrid K: Hardware next steps: schedule RMA for GPU on gpn-14-07 and take node out of rotation until replaced. Kyle, can you own RMA?
Kyle (hardware): On it. I’ll start RMA and request emergency courier. ETA on RMA parts ~48 hours standard, requesting expedited.
Saniya: Customer comms: Sending interim update to Novagrid — impacted endpoints mostly recovered; embed worker being stabilized; ETA for full resolution 48-72h pending hardware RMA.
Customer Success - Novagrid: Acknowledged. Please include mitigation steps and whether we can request capacity credits.
Matt P: Cost mitigation: temporarily served some traffic via hosted API and charged to platform-burst budget. Notifying finance.
Ingrid K: Handing off to night oncall — Matt will lead until midnight; Saniya, please continue customer comms. Ops-oncall-bot will create an incident ticket with timeline.
ops-oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026. Initial severity SEV2.
Matt P: Handoff notes: node isolated and drained, most pods rescheduled, one stateful embed worker required manual eviction; standby pool increased by +1, routing rules adjusted. Hardware RMA in progress. Monitoring for regressions.
Ingrid K: Thx — I’ll remain reachable if escalation needed.
deploy-bot: Warm node scaled up successfully and returned a healthy instance after 3m 57s.
Kyle (hardware): Filed RMA (#RMA-8891) and requested expedited shipping. Will update when courier confirmed.
Ben (infra): Adding temporary alert rules: raise severity if >1 node in novagrid-dedicated-14 reports ECC uncorrectable within 24h.
Saniya: Customer updated with list of impacted endpoints, mitigation steps, and next update planned in 2h.
Customer Success - Novagrid: Thanks — appreciate the transparency.
Matt P: Marking this thread as live-incident; will add postmortem notes after resolution. If anything regresses ping me directly.
Ingrid K: :white_check_mark: Closing active paging loop; continuing monitoring.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall at 1790123460.
ops-oncall-bot: Incident status changed to monitoring.
Matt P: last check — 99% endpoints healthy. Logging the exact kernel oops stack and attaching to INC-2026.
Ben (infra): Putting brief runbook update in docs: dedpool-hardware-failures.md (note: match GPU capabilities when failing over stateful pods).
Kyle (hardware): Courier confirmed expedited pickup; parts expected at DC in ~36h.
Saniya: Final update to customer sent. Will post final resolution when RMA complete.
Matt P: last_message_ts set to 1790124020 for record.
